about: Known, documented inconsistencies of applied Antidetect profiles (antidetect-consistency-native.mjs). A finding that matches an entry (check + browser [+ presets]) is reported as a known limit instead of failing. In a complete run an entry or browser that matched nothing is stale and fails the run: remove it once the product fixes the limit.

limits.reason: Local Date emulation is not implemented (open owner decision, ADR-104): the timezone row fixes getTimezoneOffset and Intl follows the profile zone, but Date#toString and local date fields keep the real zone offset (catalog reason of the timezone row).
ADR-105 rewrites request headers with Chrome declarativeNetRequest only; Firefox sends its native User-Agent while JavaScript reports the claimed Chrome/Edge identity.
ADR-105 rewrites request headers with Chrome declarativeNetRequest only; Firefox sends its native Accept-Language while navigator.languages reports the profile languages.
Firefox has no navigator.userAgentData and Custom never creates an API the browser lacks (ADR-048), so a Chrome/Edge claim in Firefox has no UA client hints.
Firefox has no navigator.deviceMemory and Custom never creates an API the browser lacks (ADR-048), so the claimed memory value is absent in Firefox.
